companyIntro.name: Nova Retail Group
companyIntro.mission: Run stores and online shops that customers return to and shareholders can rely on.
companyIntro.culture: Numbers on Monday, action by Tuesday. Every KPI has an owner and a weekly review.

projectBackground.name: Online Marketplace Launch — Nova Direct
projectBackground.context: Traffic is up but sales aren't. The board asks where the funnel breaks and whether the ads pay.

manager.name: Claire Whitfield
manager.role: Head of Digital, Nova Retail Group
manager.note: Traffic is vanity, conversion is sanity. Show me where we lose people and what it costs.

assignment.title: Fix the funnel
assignment.brief: Calculate conversion, AOV, abandonment and ROAS, interpret an A/B test and write the trading note.

tasks.title: Conversion Rate
tasks.prompt: 1,800 orders from 60,000 sessions. What is conversion (%)?
tasks.mistake: Using users instead of sessions changes the rate.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Average Order Value
tasks.prompt: Revenue €135,000 from 1,800 orders. What is AOV (€)?
tasks.reasoning: AOV lifts revenue without more traffic.
tasks.mistake: Chasing traffic only ignores order value.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Cart Abandonment
tasks.prompt: 7,000 carts created and 1,800 purchased. What is abandonment (%)?
tasks.reasoning: Most carts are abandoned; find why.
tasks.mistake: Treating abandonment as unavoidable loses revenue.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: ROAS
tasks.prompt: Ad spend €9,000 and attributed revenue €31,500. What is ROAS?
tasks.reasoning: ROAS must exceed break-even given margin.
tasks.mistake: A ROAS of 3.5 with 25% margin loses money.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: A/B Test
tasks.prompt: Variant B converts 3.3% against 3.0% for A after one day. What should you do?
options: Wait for the planned sample size and check significance
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Trading Note
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence trading note to the board.
tasks.modelAnswer: Conversion is 3.0% with an AOV of €75, but 74.3% of carts are abandoned, mostly at the shipping cost step. Ads return 3.5x revenue, which is profitable only if gross margin exceeds about 29%, so we need to verify margin. Next week we test a free-shipping threshold of €80 to lift AOV and cut abandonment. We'll decide after the full planned sample.
tasks.reasoning: A good note gives the key rates, the leak, margin check and next test.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Shipping Surprise
caseStudy.background: A shop added shipping costs only at the last checkout step. Abandonment hit 82% until costs were shown earlier.
caseStudy.solution: Nova shows shipping on the product page and tests thresholds.

prompts: Which funnel step would you fix first?
How do you know ads are profitable?
When do you stop an A/B test?
